venue.name: American Legion Post 372

items.information: This is the first competition in Camden County, New Jersey! This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competition Procedures tab. **This competition takes place on a Thursday Night 6PM-10PM, this is not a standard weekend competition. **
